name: Alameda High School Career Technical Education (CTE) Pathways
org: Alameda High School, Alameda Unified School District
what_you_do: You take career classes at Alameda High. There are five paths to pick from. They are digital filmmaking, multimedia, computer science, sports medicine and biotech.
who_can_apply: Students at Alameda High School. You can choose to enroll as early as 9th grade. The program page lists no other rules.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page. These are school classes.
deadline_text: The program page lists no deadlines. Ask your counselor when you pick classes.
how_to_apply: Read the CTE brochure and watch the Try Out a Career videos on the program page. Then pick CTE classes when you choose your courses. The program page links to a district enrollment page.
notes: The program page does not describe the courses in each pathway or any work based learning. School office phone: 510-337-7022. Ask the CTE teachers if a class earns college credit.
